entities.name: Query LpxK protein
observations: 375 aa bacterial protein with calculated molecular weight 40.6 kDa and theoretical pI 8.98.
Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt C6E5B2, annotated as tetraacyldisaccharide 4'-kinase.
Contains Pfam LpxK domain PF02606.21 spanning residues 28–357 with i-Evalue 8.2e-94.
Strong homologs are annotated with EC 2.7.1.130 and lipid A 4'-kinase activity.

entities.name: Lipid A 4-prime phosphorylation
observations: Transfers the gamma-phosphate of ATP to the 4'-position of a tetraacyldisaccharide 1-phosphate intermediate, producing lipid IVA, ADP, and H+.

entities.name: Lipid A biosynthesis
observations: LpxK catalyzes the final step of lipid IVA biosynthesis from tetraacyldisaccharide 1-phosphate.
The process contributes to lipid A and lipopolysaccharide core-region biosynthesis.

entities.name: LpxK ATP-binding kinase
observations: Associated molecular functions include ATP binding and lipid-A 4'-kinase activity.
Curated homolog annotations place the enzyme at the plasma membrane.
